name: French Avenue Veneno, Veneno Bianco & Veneno Scarlet Bundle
english_product_name: French Avenue Veneno, Veneno Bianco & Veneno Scarlet Bundle
description: The French Avenue Veneno Bundle brings together all three signature expressions of the Veneno line, offering a complete fragrance experience that ranges from bold intensity to smooth elegance and vibrant sweetness. Veneno delivers a powerful and captivating scent profile with rich warmth and strong presence, ideal for those who enjoy deep, attention-grabbing fragrances. Veneno Bianco introduces a cleaner and more refined composition, blending softness and subtle sweetness with a smooth, elegant feel. Veneno Scarlet adds a lively and slightly fruity twist, combining sweetness with a vibrant, modern edge. This bundle allows you to switch between moods and occasions while staying within a consistent luxury fragrance DNA. Perfect for fragrance lovers who want versatility, value, and a full exploration of the Veneno collection.
